subject: Evaluation roadmap & environment bootstrap for Azura Health POC
messages:
From: Samantha Ng <samantha@azurahealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng-infra@azurahealth.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sync: MAP + POC environment (API keys, VPC peering, allowlist)

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is keen to move forward with a short eval. We want to capture a tight MAP and confirm the environment work needed for a successful 3-week POC: org setup, API keys, IP allowlist, and VPC peering.

High-level ask: can you send a proposed timeline + ownership so we can loop in our infra and procurement? Our infra lead is on eng-infra@azurahealth.com — please include them on network/VPC requirements.

Samantha
Samantha Ng
Head of Product, Azura Health
[Attachment: initial-qa-notes.txt (TXT)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ng <samantha@azurahealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, eng-infra@azurahealth.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: MAP + POC environment (API keys, VPC peering, allowlist)

Hi Samantha — great to hear. Draft MAP below (short and actionable). I copied Lauren (eng ops) and Marissa (onboarding) to confirm timing and handoffs.

Proposed MAP (3-week evaluation)
- Week 0 (this week): Org & account setup, API keys provisioned, IP allowlist entries collected
- Week 1: VPC peering window + test calls (low-volume), sample prompts and latency checks
- Week 2: Workload ramp, cost/latency reporting, quality checks and sign-off

Owners and specific asks
- Redwood: create Azura org, issue two API keys (dev/test), provide IP allowlist ranges and peering requirements (Lauren)
- Azura: confirm firewall/NAT egress IPs, approve peering window, and share contact for peering runbook

Attachments: I’m attaching a one-page MAP and the VPC requirements spreadsheet. Lauren/Marissa — can you confirm ETA for org creation and key activation?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_map_v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: vpc_peering_requirements.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Samantha Ng <samantha@azurahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, eng-infra@azurahealth.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: MAP + POC environment (API keys, VPC peering, allowlist)

Alex/Samantha — quick update from infra ops side.

Status / next steps (Lauren)
- Org & accounts: I’ll create the Azura org in our console by EOD tomorrow (Tue 05/18). This will include a sandbox project and role-based access for your infra lead.
- API keys: We will provision two scoped keys (dev, test). Keys will be delivered via secure artifact and rotation notes in a separate email.
- IP allowlist: Please send the egress IPs for the team. If you need ephemeral / dynamic ranges, we can accept a CIDR block and provide a short-lived peering option.
- VPC peering: I reviewed the spreadsheet; primary requirements are BGP ASN (optional), allowed CIDRs, and a peering window. Proposed peering window: Wed 05/19 22:00–23:30 PDT (maintenance). Please confirm if that works for Azura infra.

Marissa — I’ll need a runbook for the key handoff and the required internal approvals.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Infra Ops, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Samantha Ng <samantha@azurahealth.com>
Cc: eng-infra@azurahealth.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: MAP + POC environment (API keys, VPC peering, allowlist)

Following up with the handoff items and checklist I’ll use for this POC. Copying the checklist below so Azura can see what to expect.

Activation checklist (Marissa)
1) Org + sandbox project created (Lauren) — done by 05/18 EOD
2) API keys: dev/test keys generated and stored in secure artifact (expected 05/19 morning)
3) Firewall IPs: Azura provides egress IPs or CIDR (please send by 05/18 noon PDT)
4) VPC peering runbook: runbook will be shared pre-window; peer test steps included
5) Validation: Redwood to run 10 low-volume test calls and share logs for visibility
6) Cost telemetry: enable token-level reporting for the trial project

Attachments: I’ll attach the activation runbook in the secure drive (link below) and paste the handoff commands for API-key activation.

[Attachment: api-key-activation.txt (TXT)]
Shared link: https://drive.redwood.com/s/azura-poc-map

If Azura confirms the peering window and sends IPs today, we are on track for Week 1 test calls on 05/20.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Onboarding Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Ng <samantha@azurahealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng-infra@azurahealth.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation roadmap & environment bootstrap for Azura Health POC

Alex / team — thanks for the clear plan. Confirming the following from Azura infra:
- Egress IPs: 54.172.10.0/28 and 18.205.33.128/27 (we will add both to your allowlist)
- Peering window confirmation: Wed 05/19 22:00–23:30 PDT works for us; eng infra will be on call (contact: Jorge Alvarez jorge.alvarez@azurahealth.com)
- Procurement: we’ve initiated the trial order and expect a PO by 05/24; we’ll share the DocuSign once approvals complete.

Please proceed with org creation and key delivery; we’ll validate test calls after the peering run.

Samantha
Samantha Ng
Head of Product, Azura Health
